LESSON: BASIC PRAYERS

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Worship
Topic 2.1: Basic Prayers

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Basic Prayers. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What are Bhajans and learner should be able to: interests in Shabads?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the qualities of  The learner be encouraged to Paramatma through basic participate in singing activities in prayers. groups/pairs 2.2 Places of worship

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: BASIC PRAYERS
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Basic Prayers helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: BASIC PRAYERS
Study Basic Prayers like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Appreciate the qualities of  The learner be encouraged to Paramatma through basic participate in singing activities in prayers. groups/pairs 2.2 Places of worship

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the qualities of  The learner be encouraged to Paramatma through basic participate in singing activities in prayers. groups/pairs 2.2 Places of worship. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the qualities of  The learner be encouraged to Paramatma through basic participate in singing activities in prayers. groups/pairs 2.2 Places of worship.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Basic Prayers” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the qualities of  The learner be encouraged to Paramatma through basic participate in singing activities in prayers. groups/pairs 2.2 Places of worship. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Basic Prayers is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Basic Prayers” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate the qualities of  The learner be encouraged to Paramatma through basic participate in singing activities in prayers. groups/pairs 2.2 Places of worship)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Basic Prayers to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate the qualities of  The learner be encouraged to Paramatma through basic participate in singing activities in prayers. groups/pairs 2.2 Places of worship.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Basic Prayers from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Basic Prayers: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Basic Prayers?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are Bhajans and learner should be able to: interests in Shabads?
2. When do we perform performed for Shabad Stavans and Buddh (6 lessons) enhancement of faith Stavan Mantra?
3. Why do we sing basic spiritual growth using audio-visual aid. prayers?
4. What features do you see worship like Deities, Bell, Deepak, inside a place of flowers etc. worship?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Basic Prayers means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate the qualities of  The learner be encouraged to Paramatma through basic participate in singing activities in prayers. groups/pairs 2.2 Places of worship.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
